iterations.verdict: Selected after direct comparison with own catalogue detail and all sixteen correctly composed directional layers. Retains squat truncated-square concrete base, broad red strip on one sloping face, framed two-column/four-row vent on adjacent face, small rounded/chamfered head and single long inclined barrel. Wear is appropriate and broad surfaces remain readable. Fine bearing, service plate, muzzle bore, hidden rear walls and dimensions are interpreted. Own MN13 directs geometry over generic Terran PB03/ST02.
